mechanism_conclusions.tep_classic: mostly stationary normal transfer; d11 is weakly separable in the selected univariate representation
mechanism_conclusions.pronto: abnormal phase drift and strong serial dependence dominate missed alarms
mechanism_conclusions.skab: normal baseline drift and low abnormal prevalence dominate false alarms despite perfect ranking

router_pronto_far_constraint.limitation: calibration-only routing cannot anticipate the observed PRONTO abnormal evaluation-phase drift; a future-event guarantee is not claimed

pronto_missed_alarm_reduction_with_far_c.failure_interpretation: recency/block adaptation recovers abnormal recall but produces unacceptable normal false alarms; do not promote without regime/change-point routing

safe_rolling_promoted.reason: the contamination guard freezes after large baseline shifts and produces excessive held-out false alarms

routing_boundary: Only calibration_applicability may route adapters. held_out_posthoc_audit is explanatory evidence and cannot tune the benchmark.
uncertainty_boundary: Each episode uses a moving-block bootstrap separately within normal and abnormal held-out partitions. Across-seed/episode standard deviations are descriptive because three seeds repeat the same physical episodes.
